header.userPrompt: When a flow is run, do we check if there's an orca run in progress? As witnessed by a progress file, along with a matching branch name? If not, we should, and we should then report an error to the user. The error should include the original prompt, with which the flow was started, along with branch information. I guess the continue-interrupted-flow detection relies on the same mechanism? So then we could say to the user - use the interrupted flow option or change the branch. That said, we could print a status line on startup, next to the "agents" and "stack" information, on which branch we currently are. This could be printed above the user-selection whenever the orca menu is presented
